rationale: Artem's deep expertise in ML infrastructure, efficient inference, and transformer architectures—demonstrated through projects like loopvlm and open-source model implementations—directly complements Raul's mission to build AI tools that expand human agency at Kite ML. With Artem's hands-on background in LLM systems and Raul's product-focused approach to developer tools, they could explore how robust ML infrastructure powers the next generation of accessible AI applications.
intro_message: Artem Yatsenko, meet Raul Romero — you're both building in the ML tooling space from different angles: Artem on the inference and architecture layer, Raul on the product experience side at Kite ML.
